correctness.rationale: For all m>=3, q>=max(2,m-2), beta>=0 and all complex-linear completions, the objective reduces exactly to a strictly convex quadratic over a spectral-norm ball. Nonendpoint columns vanish at the unique optimizer; reflection yields two orthogonal trust-region modes. The exact Dirichlet inverse gives thresholds q/2 and q(q-1)/(6(q+1)); positive finite sine spectra give unique multipliers, a complete exact trace-energy formula, and sharp frame bounds. Standard-library checker performed 6242 supplementary assertions, including exact fraction checks and independent Fourier Parseval comparisons; infinite quantifiers are handled in the proof, not asserted from experiments.

value.rationale: A natural full-Parseval host-analysis stability budget conflicts with energy-minimal completion. The complete exact Pareto frontier is derived over all linear extensions, with emergent boundary locality, two distinct parity thresholds, a sharp q-dependent frame amplification law, a finite-sum design prescription and a first nontrivial q=2 closed piecewise example. This is useful to distinguish zero padding and harmonic lifting and is not just a normalization change or reapplication of the unconstrained harmonic lemma.
